title: Spanish Prisoners of War (from Literature and Life)

Through his interactions with military personnel and the prisoners, Howells examines themes of compassion versus duty, illustrating the complexity of war's moral landscape. He captures moments of unexpected kindness, such as the feeding of the prisoners and the camaraderie that can emerge even in the context of enmity.
